provenance: Engineering acceptance policy for this authored corpus, fixed before full model evaluation; not a published benchmark score or production accuracy claim.
aggregation: Arithmetic mean over all required documents; missing documents or metrics block acceptance. Reference-only stages still require complete measurements.

parse.docling.reason: Measured comparison baseline; production selection is evaluated in parse.native.

parse.mineru.reason: External comparison baseline, never a production executor.

parse.paddle.reason: At most five percent text/order loss and ten percent structure loss; every output byte span must recover exactly. The ten merged-table sources are also gated separately so empty-table documents cannot dilute failures.

parse.native.reason: Apply the same preservation contract to the selected production parser. The ten merged-table sources are also gated separately so empty-table documents cannot dilute failures.

spans.gliner2.reason: Require ninety percent occurrence-sensitive F1, including the declared entity label separately.

spans.relex.reason: Evaluation-only relation baseline; its scores cannot gate or change production relation writes.

fields.reason: Require ninety percent per-field correctness and no invented undeclared fields.

claims.decompose.reason: O5.1 requires above-threshold stability: cosine must exceed .99 across three runs. Every authored eligible document contains a proposition, so empty sets cannot pass.

claims.verify.minicheck.reason: Require ninety percent agreement on separately authored supported and unsupported claims.

resolve.link.reason: Require ninety percent occurrence-sensitive identity agreement with entities actually created/read in the admitted tenant.

comparisons.name: O2.2_multicolumn_reading_order
comparisons.reason: Paddle may trail MinerU by at most two percentage points on the same ten multi-column sources.

comparisons.name: W1_docx_text_parity
comparisons.reason: Same authored DOCX comparison PDF: permit at most two points difference in preserved text.

comparisons.name: W1_docx_structure_parity
comparisons.reason: Same authored DOCX comparison PDF: require heading preservation parity.

comparisons.name: W1_docx_table_parity
comparisons.reason: Same authored DOCX comparison PDF: require table preservation parity.
